subject: Re: Kickoff: do large LMs actually use retrieval? (ELI5 track)
body:
Anders,

Staffing and compute for the window.

People: Quentin full-time on modeling, Wei at 30% advising on eval design, Saoirse 50% on the training harness, Emeka 60% on data plumbing for the KILT/ELI5 splits. The critical piece is the retrieval side: Rosa Mensah is committed to us at 70% for June 2026 to build the retrieval indexing and serving path - I've blocked that in the allocation sheet. Without her the REALM index rebuild slips past the July 3 ablation milestone.

Compute: GPT2-XL fine-tuning fits on 32 Titan A100s best-effort for May; I'll request a Vulcan slot for the July ablation sweeps once the harness is stable. Retrieval index builds are CPU-heavy, Corpus team says their batch tier can absorb it.

Flag: Vulcan has maintenance June 22-24, so I'm keeping all June runs on Titan to be safe.

Jelena
